messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] reserved-pool admission-throttle detected in asia-east1/dedicated-prod — sustained queue growth for 4m, agg_admit_rate=11r/s (target 40r/s), p95 tail latency rising 1.2s -> 3.0s. dashboard: https://redwood.ops/d/rr/admit?orgId=1&panelId=22
raj.sre: copying in. any recent deploys or big customers hitting dedicated pools?
maggie-ops: saw a jump ~06:37 UTC from tenant:big-ai-corp, long-context requests (16k tokens) starting then. might be correlated.
elaine-prod: we rolled model-service v3.4 to dedicated-prod at 06:35 UTC (canary to 10% then auto-roll). v3.4 increases batch-size heuristics by default.
sam-platform: admit controller is emitting churn warnings: `admit_signal_churn=true` and repeated `admit_rejected: no_free_device_slice`. logs excerpt:
```
2024-11-12T06:39:15Z admit-controller[admit-1] WARN admit_rejected tenant=big-ai-corp reason=no_free_device_slice
2024-11-12T06:39:16Z admit-controller[admit-1] INFO smoothing_window=30s oscillation=high
```
oncall-sre: I'm going to apply a temporary per-tenant burst increase (10% -> 20%) to ease backpressure, will monitor for 10m.
raj.sre: prefer scaling instead of policy blunting. can we add spare capacity to the reserved pool in asia-east1? check reserved budget.
maggie-ops: initiating add of +2 GPU nodes (g6a) to reserved-prod pool, request sent to autoscaler (job 6789). ETA ~7m.
infra-bot: autoscaler: initiated scale up +2 nodes for cluster: asia-east1-dedicated-prod (job 6789) — tracking: https://redwood.ops/cluster/asia-east1/jobs/6789
elaine-prod: pausing the v3.4 rollout to dedicated-prod canary nodes (rolling back canary to v3.3 on 2 nodes) — doing controlled rollback on canary subset.
sam-platform: also bumped admission smoothing window 30s -> 60s to reduce signal oscillation (config change pushed).
oncall-sre: p95 tail latency dropping: 3.0s -> 1.15s over last 4m, queue depth ~50 -> ~18.
raj.sre: good. follow-ups: 1) add tenant max-units cap to prevent single tenant consuming >40% of a pool; 2) add alert for 'sustained admit_signal_churn' separate from raw queue growth; create PROD-3421. assign owner: sam-platform.
maggie-ops: nodes in and healthy, kube pods scheduled, metrics look stable.
elaine-prod: rolling resume only after monitoring 15m.
oncall-sre: wrapping up — temporary burst reverted to default, smoothing window stays at 60s. conclude incident as mitigation applied; will track PROD-3421 for policy changes. :white_check_mark:
